caption: Handal v. Innovative Industrial Properties, Inc.
citation_line: Handal v. Innovative Industrial Properties, Inc., No. 2:22-cv-02359, ECF No. 67 (D.N.J. Sept. 25, 2024), aff’d, No. 24-2829 (3d Cir. Oct. 15, 2025)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Padin dismissed with prejudice a putative securities class action arising from alleged fraud by a tenant of a cannabis-focused real-estate investment trust, finding no adequately pleaded false statement and scienter combination.
qualification_rationale: The case gives precedential guidance on pleading opinion statements, falsity and scienter under § 10(b), Rule 10b-5 and the PSLRA in the wake of corporate trauma.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit affirmed in a precedential opinion, emphasizing that ill-advised or incorrect opinions do not alone amount to securities fraud and that negligence is not scienter.
decision_selection_note: The record describes dismissal with prejudice and appeal 24-2829 was filed in 2024. ECF 55 is the earlier dismissal.
